audit.corrected: No chart edits. Pillar of Ice's 21/19.5/18/16.5/15s added to mid as the mid-game window to play around.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trundle's W and E are swapped throughout: Frozen Domain is labelled (E) in three fields and Pillar of Ice is labelled (W). The page also says Chomp heals him and refers to 'Chomp lifesteal'.
audit.why: Frozen Domain is W (18/17/16/15/14s, 750 range) — attack speed, move speed and increased healing from all sources while he stands on it. Pillar of Ice is E (21/19.5/18/16.5/15s, 1000 range) and is impassable terrain, which is the interaction that actually decides fights here: it can wall off Locke's only dash. Chomp deals damage, briefly slows and saps Attack Damage on a flat 3.5s; it has no heal. His sustain is King's Tribute, healing a percentage of the max health of enemy units dying near him, amplified while he is inside Frozen Domain.
audit.corrected: W and E labels corrected everywhere; Chomp restated as an AD sap on 3.5s; the healing attributed to King's Tribute plus Frozen Domain's amplification; Pillar's terrain-versus-blink threat stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[2] tells you to buy anti-heal for 'Chomp lifesteal'.
audit.why: There is no lifesteal on Chomp; the anti-heal target is King's Tribute and Frozen Domain's healing amplification.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal retargeted to the sources that actually heal him.

notes: Trundle's W and E were swapped across the whole content layer — Frozen Domain is W, Pillar of Ice is E. That matters beyond labelling: Pillar is impassable terrain, so it is the ability that can strand Locke by blocking his only dash, and the page had that threat filed under the wrong button. Chomp does not heal either; it saps Attack Damage on a flat 3.5s, and the healing to itemise against is King's Tribute amplified by Frozen Domain.
